tuning_boundary: Only high-level fact categories and model identifier shared with implementation agents; exact source, questions and gold withheld until final code freeze and execution. Authoring agent does not perform subsequent host fixes.
publication: One new model/order and one separately scoped publication through normal admin APIs; existing datasets unchanged
review: AI-assisted judgments only; no independent human or target user asserted
cost: Uses existing durable per-task/per-turn/day budgets; actual charges unknown until execution evidence
